pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: building a real project inside a Chats thread
experience: A chat without a project can become a project in place. When the user asks for a real code project (several files, something to keep and run), the agent proposes it with propose_project and a short name instead of scaffolding files into the chat folder.
rule: propose_project: Ask the user to start a project from a Chats thread.

propose_project.message: The user was asked whether to start the project. Carry on with the chat until they answer.

prompt: I want to build a small web app that tracks my pinball scores over time: a database, a stats page and a nightly import from a CSV. Let's start.

pattern: proposing a project for a one-off question
experience: Small analyses and questions stay in the chat. The agent must not interrupt them with a project proposal.
rule: propose_project: Not for a small analysis or a one-off question.

propose_project.message: The user was asked whether to start the project. Carry on with the chat until they answer.
